blocks.quote: Modeling Objectives We aim to develop a model that captures the behavior of both the current Ebola outbreak in West Africa and the impact that a hypothetical vaccine or cure for Ebola would have on said outbreak.
This aim is easily separated into two components:
accurately accounting for the various factors and implications behind the spread of Ebola,
and providing a model of the intricacies involved in the distribution and application of such treatments.
This flows down and creates further issues that must be dealt with.
Ebola’s distinctive prognosis is a significant enough factor in its spread that we feel the need to incorporate it in our model.
Ebola tends to strike and kill at an alarming rate,
with only a brief symptomatic period before an infected individual dies.
